interpretation_limits: These are extraction/evaluation case selections for existing protocols, not protocol inventions or verified scientific reference graphs.

Holdout means excluded from future benchmark-driven tuning after registration. Prior source, graph, harness, prompt and model-training exposure cannot be ruled out; never-used or uncontaminated claims are prohibited.
Existing packet paths are leads, not current custody certification. Historical absolute source paths and hashes must be preserved; fresh remote source registrations are required.

URLs distinguish observed authoritative links, institutional/academic alternatives and unverified candidate leads. No successful download or complete source coverage follows from a URL, filename, search excerpt or browser challenge.
All necessary cited historical protocol/kit context must be assessed. Later revisions cannot silently fill unknown fields.
Model-authored graphs and LLM reviews remain provisional; human source-first verification is needed for any human-gold claim.
